project.name: FrameScope
project.description: FrameScope turns trajectory contact traces into recurring-state reports.

records.statement: The loader supplies contact frames to a metadata adapter, the clustering engine groups frame fingerprints, and the report builder exports population tables and plots.
Use complete-linkage Jaccard clustering after compressing identical fingerprints; restore frame counts before reporting populations.
Agreed: include a timeline, occurrence chart and contact heatmap by default in the first-release dashboard.
Remove the medoid-derived state_uid from the first release; retain state_id as the population rank within an analysis.
The current development task is reviewing pipeline orchestration and the report metadata adapter. That review is in progress; no completion is reported yet.
